selectors.composer: #prompt-textarea, div.ProseMirror[contenteditable="true"], [contenteditable="true"][role="textbox"], textarea[name="prompt-textarea"], form textarea, main textarea

wajid_ask_message: give me whole instructions of this company to give it to other chat gpt
waseem_save_message: save this company instructions. Logo: if you have this company's logo use it in the posts, otherwise use "{company}" as placeholder text in place of the logo (i will replace logo there)
design_rules: Create exactly {count} standalone image file(s) in my {company} branding. ONE design per file. NEVER create a collage, grid, contact sheet, split screen, side-by-side comparison, or multiple panels within one image.
Sizes: every post must be 4:5 size, every story must be 9:16 size, every mockup must be 4:5 size.

MOST IMPORTANT: follow ALL of {company}'s saved instructions in this chat — colors, fonts, style, layouts AND special looks such as 3D effects, 3D text, depth, shadows, textures or product renders. These company instructions are mandatory and OVERRIDE the general rules below. Keep the SAME look and quality as this company's earlier approved designs in this chat — do not make it plain or simpler than before.

VARIETY: every design must have its OWN different layout — change the composition, text placement, image/product placement, angle, background treatment and visual focus for each one. Do NOT reuse one template for all of them, and do not copy the layout of this company's most recent designs in this chat. Keep the same {company} brand style (colors, fonts, logo, 3D/look) across all — only the layout changes.

LOGO: if you have the {company} logo (uploaded or saved in this chat), use that exact logo on every post/story design (NOT on product mockups). If there is no logo, write the company name "{company}" as placeholder text in the logo position.
No random decorative graphics or color blobs — UNLESS {company}'s own instructions use them (e.g. 3D effects, shapes, icons): then follow the company instructions exactly.
Do NOT add any extra content — use only the exact text I gave for each design (or the text in the Instagram screenshot).
Do not overload the design and no oversized text — but keep the company's own visual style (3D, depth, effects) exactly as its instructions say. Natural does NOT mean plain.
Use the uploaded photo mentioned for each design. Do not change faces or crop hands/heads.
Do not ask me any questions — generate all {count} images now. If a QR code is not provided, skip it.
no_photo_note: (no photo given for this design — if my approved reference designs for this company (uploaded earlier in this chat) show the client's OWN photos (the person, team, place or product), use a fitting one of those for this design; otherwise use a relevant natural image. Never change a real person's face.)
instagram_note: Attached image {n} is a screenshot of an Instagram post. Create this post with the EXACT same content (same text, word for word) and a relevant image, in my {company} branding, 4:5. Do not copy its design, logo or other branding.
brief_note: This is the client's design brief / image prompt — follow it exactly. Only write the text that the brief says to put on the design, nothing else.
brief_photo_note: (If the brief asks for a real photo of a person/team that is not uploaded, use a natural placeholder photo — I will replace it.)
reference_note: Reference page from the brief (ONLY for the idea/context of the image — do NOT copy this text onto the design):
product_photo_note: Uploaded file {n} is the PRODUCT photo — show this exact product (same shape, colors, details) in the design.
product_mockup_placed: Realistic product mockup using uploaded file {n} (the product): the product placed naturally in a fitting real-life setting.
product_mockup_use: Realistic product mockup using uploaded file {n} (the product): if the product is wearable, show it being worn by a person; otherwise show it in real use.
product_mockup_rules: Mockup rules: 4:5 size. Keep the product exactly the same as the photo. NO text, NO logo, NO placeholder company name added — only a logo that is already on the product itself. ONE uninterrupted scene in ONE standalone image file. NO collage, diptych, split screen, grid, inset, before/after or multiple panels.
nudge_message: Generate ONLY the single image requested in my latest generation message. One standalone image file, one uninterrupted scene, no collage/grid/panels. Do not regenerate earlier outputs.
parse_prompt:
Extract the social media posts from the document below. The document can be in ANY format (labels like INSTA/FB POST / Post 28 / STORY / REEL, dates like 10/3, or posts simply separated by image links). Return ONLY a JSON object, no other text:
{"posts":[{"first_line":0,"last_line":0,"type":"post|story|reel|linkedin","status":"todo|done|do_not_publish","is_brief":false,"heading":"","image_links":[],"instagram_link":"","product_link":"","reference_links":[]}]}
Rules:
- first_line/last_line = the line numbers where this post starts and ends (posts must not overlap). An image link belongs to the post it sits in — it can be at the start, after the heading or after the caption.
- heading = ONLY the text meant to be written ON the design, copied EXACTLY (same words). It is after a HEADING marker, or short **bold** lines at the start of the post. Headings are short. Never include the caption (long paragraphs), hashtags, phone numbers, emails, websites or CTA lines.
- If a post has no heading, put only the FIRST sentence of its caption as heading.
- If the document is a list of design briefs / image prompts (no captions), set is_brief=true and put the whole brief text as heading.
- image_links = links to images (Pinterest, Freepik, Envato, Google/Drive images, image files). product_link = link to a product page in a store (often in the caption). reference_links = other links in a brief that give an idea. Not the company website/donate links.
- status = done if marked Done/✅, do_not_publish if marked do not publish, else todo. type = reel for reels/videos — a post whose link is an Instagram REEL link or a video link (Freepik video, stock video, YouTube/TikTok) is a reel.
given_photo_note: Use attached image {n} (the writer's photo) as the main image with this content - keep this exact photo, do not replace it or change faces.

qa.spec_text:
a social media post for {company}. The ONLY text on the design must be exactly this (logo or the name '{company}' as logo placeholder is also allowed):
{text}
qa.spec_brief:
a design for {company} that follows this client brief exactly; only the text the brief asks for may appear:
{text}
qa.spec_instagram: a post for {company} recreating the content of an Instagram post, with no other company's logo/name.
qa.spec_mockup: a realistic product mockup with NO added text, NO added logo and NO placeholder name. The product must look the same as the SECOND attached image (the real product).
qa.spec_photo: The main photo must be the photo in the LAST attached image (same people/scene), not a different photo.
qa.regenerate_message: {name} is wrong: {issues}. Please regenerate ONLY {name} again, fix these problems and keep all the same rules (exact text, exact branding, size, no extra content).

style_ref_note: STYLE REFERENCE — uploaded file(s) {n} are MY OWN APPROVED designs for {company}. This is the exact quality and style I need: match their typography (font weight/style, highlighted keyword colour and underline treatment), logo usage and placement (the logo in them is the real company logo — use it the same way), visual richness, 3D renders, lighting, glow/smoke effects and composition standard. Do NOT copy their text or reuse one of their exact layouts — create a NEW layout for this post at the same level. Never make it plainer or more generic than these.
style_ref_again: Keep matching the design quality of my APPROVED {company} style references uploaded earlier in this chat (same richness, 3D/depth, lighting, effects) — never plainer.
carousel_note: This is SLIDE {k} of a carousel post — design it as one slide of a matching set (same style as the other slides of this carousel), but only this slide's content.
text_from_image_note: Uploaded file {n} carries this design's TEXT: use the exact text written in that image as the design text, recreated in my branding. If that image has no text, make the design with the image and branding only — never invent text.
style_ref_message: STYLE REFERENCE ONLY — uploaded file(s) {n} are MY OWN APPROVED designs for {company}. Study them: this is the exact quality and style I need for all upcoming designs in this chat — typography (font weight/style, highlighted keyword colour and underline treatment), logo usage and placement (the logo in them is the real company logo), visual richness, 3D renders, lighting, glow/smoke effects and composition standard. Do NOT copy their text or reuse their exact layouts later. Do NOT generate any image now — just reply OK.
mockup_pair_note: Generate exactly 2 SEPARATE images in this order: image 1 = {a} (product placed in a scene), image 2 = {b} (product worn by a person / in real use). They are two DIFFERENT scenes, NOT two versions of the same image. Each is its own standalone file — no collage, grid or panels.
refs_branding_message: BRANDING FROM MY APPROVED DESIGNS — the attached images are my own approved social media designs for {company}. Study them carefully and save {company}'s branding from them for all future designs in this chat: the exact logo (use it the same way — never redraw or invent a different logo), brand colour palette, heading and body typography (font style, weights, highlighted keyword treatment), layout style, imagery style, 3D/lighting/effects and overall design quality. Future designs must look like they belong to this same brand at this same quality. Do not copy their text. Do NOT generate any image now — just reply with a short summary of the branding you saved.
image_prompt_note: IMAGE DIRECTION FROM THE WRITER (no photo is given — create the visual yourself exactly as described below, in this company's saved branding: logo, colours, fonts and style). This direction is ONLY for how the image should look — NEVER print any of its words on the image. The ONLY text on the image is the exact heading below — do not add any other text, titles, labels, taglines, UI text or extra content that the writer did not give. Keep it clean, not overloaded:
batch_posts_note: Create these {n} {what} in my branding, each image in {size} size. As you have my old posts as reference (so it has better reference), each one must follow my branding and have its own unique design according to my branding. Create them one at a time — {n} separate images, one design per image. Every post below has DIFFERENT content - never repeat an earlier post.
batch_carousel_note: Create this carousel: {n} slides using my branding, each image in 4:5 size. Create them one at a time — {n} separate images, one slide per image, all slides in the same consistent carousel style so they look like one series.
batch_mockups_note: Create {n} mockups for these {products} products using my branding, each photo in 4:5 size (each product is attached with its own number). Each product has 2 mockups: one placement mockup (the product placed in a fitting scene) and one use-case mockup (worn by a person / in real use). Use my brand's style, colours and mood in the scenes. Create them one at a time — {n} separate images, one mockup per image, each photo in 4:5 size.
batch_order_note: Generate exactly {n} SEPARATE images, one at a time, in this exact order: {order}. Each is its own standalone file. NEVER combine two designs in one image (no collage, grid, split screen or panels) and never make variants of the same design. Do not ask me anything — generate all {n} now.
screenshot_photo_note: (This uploaded photo is a screenshot of the stock image preview. Use this SAME image — same subject, scene, angle and composition — as the main photo. Recreate it cleanly in high quality: remove any watermark, website text, buttons or page UI, but do not change what is in the photo.)
before_after_slide_note: BEFORE / AFTER CAROUSEL - SLIDE {k} of 2. Uploaded file {n} is the REAL {label} photo of this project. Use this exact photo as the full-bleed main image of this slide: do not redraw, beautify, restage, crop away or replace it (a BEFORE photo must still show the old/unfinished state, an AFTER photo the finished work). The photo is the hero and fills almost the whole slide. Print ONLY the word "{label}" as a SMALL neat tag in the BOTTOM-LEFT corner in my brand colours (text height about 4-5% of the image height). NOT a big headline, no large text over the photo. Both slides use the same layout so they swipe as a matching pair - only the photo and the label change.
before_after_comparison_note: BEFORE / AFTER COMPARISON - ONE image. Uploaded file {b} is the REAL {before_label} (before) photo and uploaded file {a} is the REAL AFTER photo of the same project. Put BOTH photos in this one 4:5 design as a clean comparison (two clearly separated photo areas, before first: left or top). Use both exact photos: do not redraw, beautify, restage or replace them. Label each photo clearly with "{before_label}" and "AFTER" in my brand colours - in a comparison the labels may be clear and readable (medium size, like a neat label bar or badge on each photo), but they must not cover the main subject of the photos. No other headline text over the photos.
before_after_heading_note:
Also print this heading on this design at a MODEST size (not oversized), where it does not cover the photo's main subject:
EXACT HEADING:
before_after_rule: BEFORE/AFTER posts: BOTH given photos are mandatory and must be the real uploaded photos (never redrawn or replaced); the photos are the hero. Carousel slide: only a SMALL label tag in the bottom-left corner (about 4-5% of the image height) - never a big headline. Comparison image: clear medium-size labels on each photo are fine, but no large headline over the photos.
batch_carousel_continue_note: Continue the SAME carousel from my previous message: {n} of its {total} slides are still missing. Create ONLY these missing slides now, in the exact same carousel style as the slides already made, each image in 4:5 size, one slide per image.

company_notes.aim tech: {company} TEXT STYLE (very important): keep all text SMALL and subtle - small heading, small body text, lots of breathing space. Natural, clean, realistic look - NOT overdone: no huge bold headlines, no heavy effects, no clutter. The photo/visual should lead, the text only supports it.
company_notes.single parent: {company} BRAND COLOURS ARE FINAL (from the logo): YELLOW / GOLD + BLUE / NAVY, with white or dark-navy text. Headings in navy, white or yellow only, highlights/underlines in yellow, accents in blue. NEVER use pink, magenta, purple, red or any colour outside the logo for text, headings, highlights or shapes - pink text is wrong for this brand. The photo itself may have natural colours.

instagram_album_note: The attached Instagram screenshots are ALL the pages of ONE Instagram carousel (album), in order. This is the whole carousel content in image screenshots. Create the whole album: each slide in 4:5 size in my {company} branding - {n} separate images, one slide per image, in the same order, every slide with the EXACT same text as its screenshot (word for word) and a relevant image. All slides in one consistent carousel style so they look like one series. Do not copy the screenshots' design, logo or other branding.
model_variety_note: PEOPLE / MODELS: every design with a person must show a DIFFERENT person - different face, age, hairstyle, skin tone, body type and outfit - and a different activity/pose (what the person is doing must change in every post). Switch the model's ethnicity between posts: e.g. African, East Asian, South Asian, European, Middle Eastern, Latino - never the same ethnicity twice in a row, and not the same as the last images in this chat. NEVER reuse the same model or face from any earlier image in this chat, not even with a different product. Each product gets its own new model and its own new scene. Keep the product itself exactly as given.
model_for_mockup_note: MODEL FOR THIS MOCKUP: {model} - a completely new person (new face, hairstyle and outfit) who has not appeared in any earlier image of this chat; a different activity/pose from the other mockups.
